result.label: Fund Vehicle
result.definition: A legal entity that pools investor capital to make investments. Not disjoint with SPV or Portfolio Company.

result.label: Clearance
result.definition: A dated decision on whether a party's tax documentation supports its treatment as an investor in a fund vehicle, with the certifications and facts relied on and any open items. A renewed or withdrawn clearance is a new record; earlier records are kept.

result.label: Distribution Event
result.definition: A distribution proposed or made by a fund vehicle to its investors, with a record date and a payment date. The cash transfers it gives rise to are payment events.

result.label: Portfolio Company
result.definition: A legal entity in which a fund holds an investment, directly or indirectly.

result.label: Role Assignment
result.definition: The fact that a party plays a role of a given type in the context of a fund vehicle, under an agreement.

result.label: committedCapital
result.definition: Total capital committed to the fund vehicle, in the fund currency.

result.label: currencyCode
result.definition: ISO 4217 currency of a payment or of a fund vehicle's commitments.

result.label: distributedBy
result.definition: The fund vehicle making the distribution.
